# Netflix Analytics Studio

A completed interactive analytics project developed by
**Ummi Habiba** using Python, pandas, Plotly, and Streamlit.

## Project Features

- Automatic dataset loading
- Title and catalog filters
- Movie and TV-show comparison
- Release-year timeline
- Genre treemap
- Country analysis
- Data-quality reporting
- Rule-based recommendations
- Random title discovery
- Downloadable filtered results

## Dataset

Netflix Movies and TV Shows dataset by Shivam Bansal.

Source:
https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/shivamb/netflix-shows

License: CC0 — Public Domain.

## Important Note

This project analyzes a static catalog dataset. It does not
represent Netflix viewers, streams, popularity, revenue, or
Netflix's internal recommendation technology.

## Technologies

- Python
- pandas
- Plotly
- Streamlit
